cd /app && python3 - <<'PY'
import re
pat=re.compile(r'^\s*(\w+)\s*,\s*(\w+)\s*,\s*(\w+)\s*$')
bad=0
samples=set()
with open('input.csv') as f:
    for i,l in enumerate(f):
        l=l.rstrip('\n')
        m=pat.match(l)
        if not m:
            bad+=1
            if bad<10: print('BAD',i,repr(l))
        else:
            samples.add(tuple(m.groups()))
print('bad',bad,'unique triples',len(samples))
print(list(samples)[:10])
PY
